claims.statement: For every ordinary tree T of order 14 with p=6 satisfying x(T)+2<=6 and 18<2alpha(T)+1, the full fixed-selector aggregate S(T,6) is at most -222; equality occurs.
claims.scope: Bounded exact computation over all ordinary tree isomorphism classes of order 14 at p=6, the order-14 instance of |T|=2p+2, subject to the stated guards.
claims.reason: retained. Scratch replay regenerated 3,159 order-14 free-tree codes, selected the same 240 eligible classes, subset-replayed every complete sum, and matched all 240 source (tree_code,S) pairs. The exact finite convex-combination bound is sharp at -222. The route claim is valid at this bounded scope only.

limitations: The result covers only order 14 and p=6; it does not prove the first-order shell for arbitrary p or settle the universal primary aggregate.

Replay reused the pinned centroid generator. It independently checked polynomial coefficients, strict eligibility, selectors, deletion counts, and full sums by subset enumeration, but did not implement a second free-tree generation algorithm.
